d.ko: Horns of Deliverance is a first-person action roguelike with grounded gunplay where you need to consume psychoactive substances to prevent your brain chip from taking over.

d.zh: 《救赎号角》是一款有写实射击场景的第一人称类Rogue游戏，在游戏中玩家需要服用精神药物， 以防止脑芯片接管你的身体。
